newsitem.title: USA: USDA Undersecretary Moos resigns effective Dec 31.
newsitem.headline: USDA Undersecretary Moos resigns effective Dec 31.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Undersecretary Gene Moos resigned, effective Dec 31, to retire, an aide said Wednesday.
"He's making it public. He submitted his resignation to the secretary (of agriculture) effective Dec 31," the aide said. "He thinks it's time to step down...it's a good breaking point."
For the past four years, Moos, 71, was in charge of USDA's farm support programs and export programs. During his career, he was a key aide to House Speaker Tom Foley and a well-placed consultant.
